messages:
anna: quick UX question: our Go Generator Resume API is tripping users who accidentally reuse short-lived ctxs. sample app demonstrates 3 patterns and a proposed Attach helper. feedback?
jorge: can you paste the snippet?
anna: sure. core naive pattern folks use: 
```go
// caller used request-scoped ctx and kept it around
sess := client.Generators.NewSession(reqCtx, opts)
for tok := range sess.Stream() { handle(tok) }
if sess.Detached() { resumed, err := client.Generators.Resume(reqCtx, sess.ID) }
```
This fails when reqCtx had a deadline that already passed -> immediate ErrDeadlineExceeded.
mira: yeah that was exactly what broke a sampleapp in CI: reused request ctx for Resume. sigh.
jorge: options: document explicitly, add ResumeWithHandshakeTimeout(ctx, d), or hide handshake by adding sess.Attach() that does its own short-lived handshake ctx.
anna: proposal: add Session.Attach(ctx) which: (1) creates internal handshake ctx with configurable default 5s, (2) returns a Stream and a ResumeFunc that callers can call with their own ctx for subsequent restarts, (3) emits metric gen.resume.path={attach-helper, direct-resume}.
mira: also: we currently map server-driven detaches to io.EOF which makes it impossible to tell whether generator finished or got cut off by auth rotation. Suggest adding a sentinel ErrStreamDetached and a Stream.DetachReason() string for observability.
jorge: ErrStreamDetached seems reasonable. keep io.EOF for normal end. provide a compat flag so integrators can opt in first release.
anna: server-side follow-up: Resume should be idempotent so retries don't cause duplicate chunks. advise server to accept cursor + idempotency token and return 409 for incompatible replay. SDK can translate 409 -> ErrDuplicateReplay.
mira: test plan: sampleapp includes three recipes: (A) reuse request ctx -> fail, (B) create fresh ctx for Resume -> succeed, (C) use Attach helper -> succeed ergonomically. add unit tests asserting ErrStreamDetached vs io.EOF.
ci-bot: CI started: gen-resume-ux-tests :construction:
ops-bot: Incident 2026-03-22T07:12Z: token-service restart caused short auth window; some generator sessions detached mid-stream.
jorge: action items: anna -> PR with sampleapp + README; mira -> SDK change: Session.Attach + ErrStreamDetached behind opt-in flag; infra -> make server Resume idempotent and return clear status codes.
anna: I'll open the PR now and ping y'all. thanks for the quick input :pray:
